answer: Typing sessions are fingerprinted by burst-pause rhythm, the pauses where a human thinks. Generating 226 believable burst-pause patterns means modeling 226 different thinking rhythms. Each epoch re-measures the rhythm on a fresh text sample. The ocean check runs in the open: 226 fakes pay the full price 226 times, one honest agent pays once, and the grove trail in the ledger makes the quill cost visible to everyone.
